SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE 1 = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS totalProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 'onsale' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS onsaleProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS totalOrders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS gmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = 'auditing' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS pendingAudits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = r.reporter_id WHERE r.status = 'pending' AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS pendingReports, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_dispute d JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_id = d.order_id WHERE d.status = 'pending' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS pendingDisputes
SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS value FROM product_category_dict c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.cat_l1 = c.code AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE c.level = 1 GROUP BY c.code, c.name

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE publish_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS publishCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE publish_time >= CURDATE() AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS publishToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS dealCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS dealGmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'done' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS doneCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS buyerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT buyer_id FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY buyer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) t) AS repeatBuyerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_dispute d JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_id = d.order_id WHERE d.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS disputeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'unshipped' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS overdueUnshippedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_order WHERE status = 'unpaid' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS unpaidCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS gmv FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS publishCount FROM product WHERE publish_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.title, p.cover, p.price, p.status, p.cat_l1 AS catL1, p.publish_time AS publishTime, u.nick_name AS sellerNickName, u.user_id AS sellerId, m.risk_level AS aiRiskLevel, m.action AS aiAction, m.summary AS aiSummary, m.violations AS aiViolations FROM product p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ai_moderation_log m ON m.log_id = ( SELECT ml.log_id FROM ai_moderation_log ml WHERE ml.biz_type = 'product' AND ml.biz_id = p.product_id AND ml.action != 'error' ORDER BY ml.log_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND p.status = #{status}
AND p.status IN ('auditing', 'onsale', 'rejected')
AND m.risk_level IN ('medium', 'high')
AND m.action IN ('auto_pass', 'auto_reject')
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT user_id AS userId, username, nick_name AS nickName, avatar, user_type AS userType, phonenumber, status, create_time AS createTime FROM sys_user
AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR phonenumber LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY user_id DESC

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS totalGmv, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM trade_order WHERE status IN ('unshipped','shipped','done') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS paidGmv, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rf.amount), 0) FROM trade_refund rf JOIN trade_order o ON o.order_id = rf.order_id WHERE rf.status = 'refund_success' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS refundedGmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_withdraw w WHERE w.status = 'pending' AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS pendingWithdraws
